newsitem.title: USA: Chartwell in alliance with Hilton Inns.
newsitem.headline: Chartwell in alliance with Hilton Inns.

text.p: Chartwell Leisure Inc Monday said it formed a strategic alliance with Hilton Hotels Corp's Hilton Inns Inc in which Chartwell will own, develop, manage and operate 20 Hilton Garden Inn hotels in target markets nationwide under a franchise license.
The initial term of the agreement is three years and represents a total investment of nearly $200 million by Chartwell, it said.

Construction financing and permanent mortgage financing have been arranged for the Hilton Garden Inn development program through Nationsbank and Nomura Securities. Of the total construction costs, Nationsbank will provide up to 80 percent of the financing, with Hilton guaranteeing 25 percent of the loan. Chartwell will put up the remaining 20 percent of the capital as equity.

Chartwell will commence construction of its first Hilton Garden Inn shortly at Albuquerque International Airport and this spring will start construction of its second Hilton Garden Inn site in Santa Fe, New Mexico. Chartwell will break ground on other Hilton Garden Inns as more sites are secured.

Richard Fisher, chairman and chief executive of Chartwell, said, "This alliance helps to diversify our active expansion program, which began more than a year ago through our relationship with HFS (Inc ), one of the world's leading hotel franchisors."

Stephen Bollenbach, president and CEO of Hilton, said "Through this strategic alliance with Chartwell Leisure, we will be able to aggressively expand our very successful Hilton Garden Inn franchising program."
